title: Set up headless NNTP test harness with slrn expect scripts
description:
Create a test harness that starts a reader daemon on a random port, runs slrn in batch/script mode (slrn has --batch and scoring/hook support), and captures its output for assertion. Alternatively use a Tcl expect or Python pexpect script to drive slrn. Artifact: tests/harness/ directory with: start_reader.sh, slrn_driver.py (or .tcl), and a Makefile target.

Acceptance criteria:
- Harness starts reader on ephemeral port, connects slrn, runs a canned command sequence, checks output
- Harness is idempotent: successive runs with same data produce identical assertions
- Harness tears down reader process on exit (including on test failure)
- Documented dependency list: slrn version, expect/pexpect version
